title: For My Girls Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: For My Girls is a 5 BR / 5 BA / 11 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. The first time you see For My Girls, you’ll be reminded right away of how stunning the Seaside area really is.
description_expanded: Description52 SEASIDE AVENUE2 KINGS, 2 QUEENS, 2 TWINS (maximum occupancy is 9) Welcome to For My Girls in Seaside, FloridaFrom the moment you arrive at For My Girls, you’re reminded why Seaside, Florida is one of the most iconic coastal destinations on 30A. The home’s sunny palette, classic coastal architecture, and famously charming front porch immediately set the tone for a memorable beach getaway. This celebrated porch has been featured in The Coastal Cottage and on Oprah.com’s list of the 7 Prettiest Summer Porches, making it the perfect place to sip morning coffee or unwind with an evening cocktail as the town strolls by.Thoughtfully Designed Living SpacesStep inside and feel instantly at home in this elegant yet welcoming retreat. The main level features a spacious double living area centered around a cozy fireplace, offering plenty of room for gathering, relaxing, and reconnecting. The open-concept design flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen, where Viking appliances, generous counter space, and a separate bar for food prep and drinks make cooking and entertaining effortless—whether you’re preparing a casual breakfast or hosting a coastal-inspired dinner.Gourmet Kitchen & EntertainingDesigned with both form and function in mind, the kitchen invites you to enjoy every part of the day. From afternoon snacks to evening cocktails, the professional-grade appliances and ample workspace ensure every meal feels like a special occasion. The adjacent bar area doubles as the perfect spot for mixing drinks or setting out hors d’oeuvres before a night out in Seaside.Five Bedrooms for Rest & PrivacyFor My Girls offers five beautifully appointed bedrooms, each inspired by soothing aquatic hues. The primary king suite is a true retreat, featuring two full bathrooms—his and hers—for added comfort and privacy. On the second floor, a second king primary suite includes its own ensuite bath and provides a peaceful space to get ready for evenings around town.Two additional queen bedrooms on this level offer private bathrooms, one with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and the other with a dedicated workspace ideal for remote work, plus a private furnished porch. A loft-style twin bedroom near the tower comfortably accommodates two more guests, making this home ideal for families and groups.Media Room, Tower Views & Sunset MomentsWhat truly sets this home apart is the second-floor media room and wet bar—perfect for movie nights, relaxing afternoons, or enjoying a nightcap with friends. From there, head up to the open-air tower, where bar-top seating and built-in custom benches offer breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico and Seaside’s rooftops. This is the ultimate spot to toast the day and watch unforgettable sunsets over the water.A Seaside Stay to RememberFrom its nationally recognized porch to its thoughtfully curated interiors and stunning Gulf views, For My Girls delivers a Seaside vacation experience that is both relaxing and unforgettable. Whether you’re gathering with family, reconnecting with friends, or celebrating a special occasion, this exceptional home provides the perfect backdrop for lasting memories on Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A.Need more room? For My Girls can sleep an additional two in the guest cottage "Bingo's Bungalow".* Saturday to Saturday, 7-night minimum required year round. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES3,375 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessHis and her bathrooms in the primary bedroomBar area with wine fridge and freestanding ice makerFunctional home officeMedia roomHigh-end appliances throughoutPrivate tower with spectacular Gulf viewsPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001915
